api.success: historyReady(requestId,QcHistoryReply): private members with value-copy getters; dataset/control/project/association IDs+names, current/previous batch identity, rule configs, raw HistoryRows, unknown per-row/type unit evidence, worker-prepared per-used-type Selection/Summary/validRawCount
api.failure: historyError(requestId,associationId,code,message); native/driver/database SQL text retained, no success/partial reply. This dedicated channel does not trip the editable CRUD error callbacks.
api.thread_and_lifecycle: GUI issues queued requests; SQL begins/uses/commits/rolls back only in QcStore owning thread. Source SQL handles and QObjects never appear in replies. Normal close resets readiness; later requests report not_initialized.
api.identity: Resolve local stable association ID then selected control/project/current+previous batch names. Recheck live local dataset UUID, registered catalog schema/canonical path/exact hold/project/result identities in read snapshots; disabled history remains readable. Query never runs reconcileReferences or writes missing holds.
api.sql_snapshot: Local read snapshot then catalog read snapshot in existing local->catalog order. SELECT/BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK only; commits before CPU parsing. No cross-file atomic-write claim.
api.boundedness: 10000 rows,65536 UTF16 chars/result,2Mi total result chars,64 date/time chars and up to4 types are private offline budgets, not instrument specs. SQL metadata/byte preflight plus actual UTF16/row count checks; embedded NUL cannot bypass raw byte limits. Over limit returns error, no silently truncated success. No new index/schema/write API.
api.query_cost_limit: Returned data/parser memory is bounded; existing legacy table has no new index, so a very large whole DB can still require scans. Actual max-scale worker CPU/memory/response remains to measure.
api.ordering: Previous batch first then current; each date DESC,time DESC,id DESC. Same-day tuple duplicates retained. time/id order is explicit deterministic completion of old date-only ordering, not claimed original SQL behavior.
api.unit_truth: Legacy quality_data contains no per-point saved unit/ratio/decimals. Every returned point/type is UnknownLegacy (empty unit/NaN ratio), regardless of association or latest catalog snapshots. No automatic unit conversion or unknown/mixed-unit statistics. Raw valid numeric counts stay explicit; no fabricated zero.
api.empty_states: Empty,NoCurrentBatch andNoEnabledResults are distinct complete replies; current batch with no rows may return previous rows but core legacyCardVisible=false retains original hidden card behavior. No implicit default repair.
api.cpu_phase: Worker prepares each used-result Selection and Summary after releasing SQL snapshots; GUI does not repeat parser/statistics. First implementation calls original selectHistory up to4 times. Parse caching/resource optimization is separately pending without changing verified ordering/meaning.
api.clinical_boundary: These are stored daily-result summaries/last daily result, not per-measurement samples, optical waveforms or calibration concentration points. No normal/warning/out-of-control/clinical fit/evaluation/device/write/import API is added.
